tool_args.rationale: Fit the authorized coupled two-state memory ODE to eight observations. For each candidate fast time constant, calculate initial memory from the irregular prefix using shifted endpoint-relative exponential weights, then integrate forward with RK4 and numerically estimate all four parameters.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The existing eight rows reach the supplied minimum for fitting the four-parameter ODE; the observed signatures and irregular raw prefixes directly support this mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Open-branch discriminating probe / Maxwell snapshot law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot signatures identify history-conditioned transient dynamics; a present-snapshot law omits the measured history gap.

considered_alternatives.option: Coarse adiabatic slow-ODE or static linear model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These discard the fast coupled memory state and are inconsistent with the observed coupled transient lag.
